core: Both communities build paired versions of the same underlying task that keep the actual required action identical but differ only in surface-level presentation — reworded/reformatted phrasing in one case, irrelevant added context in the other — and then compare agent performance or behavior between the two paired versions to see how much the surface difference alone affects the outcome.
quote_1: wording-only variants of the same twenty tasks.
quote_2: The benchmark paired each account-management task with a version containing irrelevant policy excerpts, historical tickets, and decoy URLs.
